note.text: Command naming decision: the supported user-facing command for starting or connecting to Codex in the project MicroVM is vm-codex. The supported command for opening a direct shell in the same MicroVM is vm-shell. Replace earlier codex-vm naming in the design and documentation. Both commands must resolve the current project's identity and durable state consistently, target the same VM instance, avoid host-side evaluation of project code, give actionable diagnostics when prerequisites or the VM are unavailable, and document whether vm-shell starts the VM or requires an already running instance.
